summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) after show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal (no Windows calls, no exception handling); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title) once per control. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). CHANGELOG.md gained an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Not verified: tests were not run and Black formatting was not run; line lengths were checked by hand against 88 characters. Nothing is committed.
